data.value.Prices_Resources.ammo.descrip: Hidden value on each unit for use by mods

data.value.Prices_Resources.X.descriptio: Any resource defined in [global_resource_x] or [resource_x] sections
data.sections.action.text.description: Labels the action. Supports dynamic text
data.sections.action.textPostFix.descrip: Text shown as suffix, useful with textAddUnitName to create text UI
data.sections.action.text_{LANG}.descrip: Alternative text for different language. Use ISO 639-1 Language code on the {LANG} prefix. Supports dynamic text
data.sections.action.description.descrip: A display text when you select your unit's action, used to explain it's purpose. Supports dynamic text
Alternative description for different language. Use ISO 639-1 Language code on the {LANG} prefix. Supports dynamic text
data.sections.action.displayType.descrip: Affects how the action button and text is displayed. Options: none, rally, upgrade, queueUnit, building, action, infoOnly, infoOnlyNoBox, infoOnlyStockpile
data.sections.action.displayRemainingSto: Queue is shown as number of times action can be triggered based on price. Use dynamic text on text as alternative.
data.sections.action.pos.description: Order action appears in UI. Merges with positions from canBuild buttons
data.sections.action.iconImage.descripti: Sets a thumbnail image for the action button
data.sections.action.iconExtraImage.desc: Drawn over top of icon image. Useful for upgrade icons, etc
When the condition is met, the extras for icon is visible.
data.sections.action.unitShownInUI.descr: Display this unit. (as if this action built this unit)
data.sections.action.guiBuildUnit.descri: Uses the UI similar when building structures. An alternative to fireTurretX on some cases
data.sections.action.setBuilt.descriptio: Designates how built the unit is from a percentage of 0-100% with a number between 0 and 1.
data.sections.action.tags.description: To be used with the withTag parameter for self.queueSize(withTag=x) and queueItemAdded and queueItemCanceled events
data.sections.action.id.description: Allow same/equivalent actions to be more easily connected when converting between units, to preserve queues, calldowns, etc. (Normally action order is used but can be unstable.)
data.sections.action.textAddUnitName.des: Add this unit's name to this action's text
data.sections.action.descriptionAddFromU: Add this unit's description to this action's description
data.sections.action.descriptionAddUnitS: Add this unit's stats (eg HP, energy, resources) to this action's description
data.sections.action.unitShownInUIWithHp: Unit Shown In UI With HP Bar
default true, Only used when unitShownInUI is a unitRef
data.sections.action.unitShownInUIWithPr: Unit Shown In UI With Progress Bar
default true, Only used when unitShownInUI is a unitRef. Replaces HP bar if active
data.sections.action.alwaysSinglePress.d: Defaults false. When true no confirmation needed on mobile, when used with canPlayerCancel:false and allowMultipleInQueue:false will also hide the queue interface.
data.sections.action.price.description: The price of your action for the unit. Disables action if not available. Defaults to credits if unlabelled
data.sections.action.isActive.descriptio: Defaults true. If false then action is disabled and shown in red in UI.
data.sections.action.isVisible.descripti: Defaults true. If false action is hidden from UI and disabled.
data.sections.action.isLocked.descriptio: Defaults false. If true action is disabled, and a lock icon is shown. Mostly used for no nuke game modes
data.sections.action.isLockedMessage.des: Shows the message when the isLocked's condition is met
data.sections.action.isLockedAlt.descrip: Another reason for this to be locked. Can just use OR on isLocked, but this allows a different message to be shown
data.sections.action.allowMultipleInQueu: When false makes it so only one action can be queued of this type (useful for keeping actions with conditions from being spammed)
data.sections.action.onlyOneUnitAtATime: Only One Unit At A Time
When action is picked in UI, only one unit selected with get this action. Defaults to false.
data.sections.action.isGuiBlinking.descr: Flashes in UI to draw attention to it. Might be annoying if used often, recommended only for temporarily states/messages
data.sections.action.isAlsoViewableByAll: Allows ally players to see actions from this unit, useful for showing stats to other players (eg missile count, items collected)
data.sections.action.isAlsoViewableByEne: Allows enemy players to see actions from this unit, useful for showing stats to other players (eg missile count, items collected)
data.sections.action.ai_isHighPriority.d: Use this for faction selection actions or other high priority actions such as building high priority units
data.sections.action.ai_isDisabled.descr: Defaults false. Stop AI using this action. (Note when ai_isHighPriority is true this might be ignored)
Action will be triggered when an event is happening on a particular unit. Options: created, completeAndActive, destroyed, killedAnyUnit, queuedUnitFinished, queueItemAdded(withActionTag="#"), queueItemCancelled(withActionTag="#"), teleported, touchTargetSuccess, newWaypointGivenByPlayer, teamChanged, transportingNewUnit, transportUnloadedOrRemovedUnit, tookDamage(withTag="#"), newMessage(withTag="#"), enteredTransport, leftTransport, attachmentRemoved. withTag parameter for tookDamage uses tag from projectile and it is optional. withTag parameter for newMessage uses message tags.
data.sections.action.autoTriggerOnEventR: Auto Trigger On Event Recursion Limit
Defaults to 1. Prevents loops, useful with triggering itself so it doesn't infinitely triggers, good for repeating action effect on event
data.sections.action.autoTrigger.descrip: When true triggers the effects of this action instantly (ignoring price, isActive, isVisible, buildSpeed, etc)
data.sections.action.autoTriggerCheckRat: options: everyFrame (default), every4Frames, every8Frames. This overrides autoTriggerCheckRate set on [core] Note: all triggers regardless of check rate are checked when first created and after an auto trigger cooldown. Note: Adding [core]autoTriggerCheckRate:every8Frames to all-units.template could have a large performance boost for mods with complex autoTriggers.
data.sections.action.buildSpeed.descript: Sets how fast the action has to be queued before doing the action behaviors
data.sections.action.highPriorityQueue.d: Defaults to false. If true this action skips all other low priority actions in queue. Useful for fireTurret actions.
data.sections.action.canPlayerCancel.des: Defaults to true. When false, players cannot cancel this particular action.
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_cannot: Stops unit moving while action is being applied. Useful for deploy like actions.
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_playAn: Plays a specified animation while the action is queued.
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_rotate: Rotate unit body to this direction when action is in active queue.
When Building Rotate To Or Backwards
If true allow rotation in 180 degrees from whenBuilding_rotateTo when this is a smaller angle
When Building Rotate To Wait Till Rotated
Pause action queue till rotation is finished
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_tempor: Convert to another unit while action is in active queue. Note: actions from the original unit will be kept
When Building Temporarily Convert To Keep Fields
Don't change these fields when using whenBuilding_temporarilyConvertTo (both to and from)
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_trigge: While action is queued, another action is triggered.
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_rotate: When Building Rotate To Aim At Action Target
While action is queued, the unit is rotated to the target. Often used with fireTurretX actions
When Building Rotate To Rotate Turret X
While action is queued, a specified turret is aimed at the target. Often used with fireTurretX actions
data.sections.action.spawnEffectsOnQueue: Effects to spawn at unit when action is first added to queue
data.sections.action.playSoundToPlayerOn: Play Sound To Player On Queue
Global sound to play to unit's player only when action is first added to queue
Skip all effects of this action if this evaluates to false
data.sections.action.convertTo.descripti: Convert your unit into another unit. properties are preserved.
data.sections.action.convertTo_keepCurre: Keep current and temporarily tags and ignores default tags on convertTo target.
Don't change these fields when converting, useful with setUnitStats (Allowed fields: maxHp, maxEnergy, moveSpeed)
data.sections.action.addEnergy.descripti: Adds energy to unit. Has no effect unless energyMax is set. (Same as addResources: energy=X)
data.sections.action.addResources.descri: Add these resources when action finishes.
data.sections.action.addResourcesScaledB: Add Resources Scaled By AI Handicaps
Same as addResources, but increased or decreased depending on AI difficulty level.
data.sections.action.addResourcesWithLog: Like addResources but allows logic to be used for the resource value
data.sections.action.setResourcesWithLog: Sets target resources to this value instead of adding. Becareful with global resources.
data.sections.action.deleteSelf.descript: Remove self with no explosions or sounds
data.sections.action.setBodyRotation.des: Rotates the unit to a particular direction. Supports dynamic values
data.sections.action.setUnitStats.descri: Allows changing of a select number of fields dynamically without converting. Supports =/+=/-=, with dynamic maths/logic. Changeable fields: maxHp, hp, maxShield, shield, shieldRegen, maxEnergy, energy, armour, mass, shootDelayMultiplier, moveSpeed, maxTurnSpeed, maxAttackRange, fogOfWarSightRange, nanoRange, selfRegenRate, targetHeight, nanoFactorySpeed. (targetHeight adjust the unit's height gradually relative to its current height, unlike setting it with setHeight)
data.sections.action.resetUnitStats.desc: Reset changes made by setUnitStats to base values
data.sections.action.setUnitMemory.descr: Change this unit's memory, values can be set with logic. Memory must first be defined with defineUnitMemory
data.sections.action.setHeight.descripti: Changes unit height based on this height value
data.sections.action.setCustomTarget1.de: Used for unit linking without requiring unit memories or markers. It is the unit that built this by default.
data.sections.action.setCustomTarget2.de: Like setCustomTarget1 and with the same use. It is none by default.
data.sections.action.sendMessageTo.descr: Sends a message to a targeted unit
data.sections.action.sendMessageWithTags: Useful for message detection in an autoTriggerOnEvent event, eg autoTriggerOnEvent:newMessage(withTag='xyz')
data.sections.action.sendMessageWithData: The data that will be sent to the targeted unit. Allows multiple key-value pairs with any dynamic data type, use eventData() to read this data in the event
data.sections.action.refundAllQueuedItem: Refunds the spent price in the queue of a specific action; Includes set flags in price
data.sections.action.removeAllQueuedItem: Remove All Queued Items Without Refund
Similar to refundAllQueuedItems, but does not refund
data.sections.action.alsoTriggerAction.d: Trigger to results of another action as well. Ignores action's requirements.
data.sections.action.alsoQueueAction.des: Adds another action into the normal unit's queue. Ignores action's requirements
data.sections.action.alsoTriggerOrQueueA: Also Trigger Or Queue Action Conditional
Defaults true. alsoTriggerAction and alsoQueueAction are ignored if this works out to be false.
Also Trigger Or Queue Action With Target
Changes the target of the triggered action, normally defaults to the current action target. Effects things like fireTurretXAtGround, spawnUnits, thisActionTarget(), etc
data.sections.action.alsoTriggerActionRe: Repeats the alsoTriggerAction call, thisActionIndex changed on each repeat - Useful to create loops or work with arrays
data.sections.action.playSoundAtUnit.des: Local sound to play when action finishes
data.sections.action.playSoundGlobally.d: Global sound to play to all players in game
data.sections.action.playSoundToPlayer.d: Global sound to play to unit's player only
data.sections.action.fireTurretXAtGround: When action finishes fire target turret at point on ground, bypasses canShoot rules in turret.
Fire Turret X At Ground With Offset
If not set player targets the ground with GUI, if a point is set this step is skipped
Fire Turret X At Ground With Projectile
Used with fireTurretXAtGround. Defaults to target turret's normal projectile.
Fire Turret X At Ground With Target
Fires a turret aimed at the location of the indicated unit or marker
Fire Turret X At Ground Count
Number of projectiles to fire. Defaults to 1
Fire Turret X At Ground Only Over Passable Tile Of
Only allow tiles crossable by this movement type to be selected (e.g., LAND,BUILDING,WATER,HOVER)
Fire Turret X At Ground Show Guide Decals
Draws decals at the target location. Recommend setting up decals with layer: inactive
data.sections.action.spawnUnits.descript: Spawn units at action's target. See 'Spawn units line' section in this doc for details.
data.sections.action.produceUnits.descri: Like spawnUnits but unit exits as if it was produced normally, and gets a move away waypoint
Offsets unit position absolutely by this point. Format: [x,y,height]
data.sections.action.teleportTo.descript: Changes unit position to this position. Great alternative to fireTurretX with teleporting projectile
data.sections.action.addUnitsIntoTranspo: Creates and add units into transport, use self.transportingCount() to check for space before adding
{Currently broken in 1.15 - don't use} Instantly tries to transports existing units on the map into this transport. Might fail if rules don't allow this unit to be transported.
data.sections.action.deleteNumUnitsFromT: Removes a specified amount of cargo units
Delete Num Units From Transport Only With Tags
Removes a specified amount of cargo units, but only those with specified tags
data.sections.action.forceUnloadTranspor: For unload all units, or slot targeted by forceUnloadTransportNow_onlyOnSlot. Unloads even if no space or overwater, etc
Force Unload Transport Now Only On Slot
Focuses the force unload to a specific slot
data.sections.action.clearAllWaypoints.d: Clears all waypoints, be careful not to annoy players by removing their orders, prepending waypoints is often better
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_type.de: Adds a waypoint with a specific purpose. Options: move, attackMove, guard, loadInto, loadUp, attack, reclaim, repair, touchTarget, build, follow, setPassiveTarget
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_prepend: Add to the start of the waypoint queue or the end
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_trigger: Add Waypoint Trigger Action If Failed
If target_nearestUnit fails to find a match so waypoint cannot be added then trigger this action
Add Waypoint Trigger Action If Matched
Triggers an action if a waypoint is legal
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_maxTime: Automatically remove this waypoint if it has been active for longer than this time.
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_target_: Add Waypoint Target Nearest Unit Tagged
Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit with specific tags
Add Waypoint Target Nearest Unit Team
Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit with a specific relation to the player's unit. Options: own, neutral, allyNotOwn, ally, enemy, any, notOwn
Add Waypoint Target Nearest Unit Max Range
Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit within the maximum range specified.
Add Waypoint Target Map Must Be Reachable
Puts the waypoint only if the waypoint target is reachable by the unit (e.g., if a unit cannot cross two islands, the waypoint is not placed.)
Puts the waypoint to a marker or a reference unit
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_positio: Add Waypoint Position Offset From Self
Puts the waypoint to an absolute coordinate
Puts the waypoint taken from an action that triggered this action
Add Waypoint Position Random Offset From Self
Puts the waypoint to a random relative coordinate
Add Waypoint Position Relative Offset From Self
Puts the waypoint to a relative coordinate
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_target_: Add Waypoint Target Random Unit Tagged
Puts the waypoint to a random unit with specific tags
Add Waypoint Target Random Unit Team
Puts the waypoint to a random unit with a specific relation to the player's unit. Options: own, neutral, allyNotOwn, ally, enemy, any, notOwn
Add Waypoint Target Random Unit Max Range
Puts the waypoint to a random unit within the maximum range specified.
data.sections.action.addAllActionCooldow: Adds cooldown on all actions, including canBuilds
data.sections.action.addActionCooldownTi: Player cannot use action again for this amount of time
data.sections.action.addActionCooldownAp: Add Action Cooldown Apply To Actions
Sets addActionCooldownTime's target. Defaults to this action.
data.sections.action.clearAllActionCoold: Removes all existing cooldowns on all buttons
data.sections.action.playAnimation.descr: Plays animation when the action is triggered
data.sections.action.playAnimationIfNotP: Don't restart animation if this animation is already playing
data.sections.action.finishPlayingLastAn: Finish last animation, including blend out
data.sections.action.stopLastAnimation.d: Stop last animation, skipping blend out
data.sections.action.switchToNeutralTeam: Change team to neutral. This team is allied to all other teams. Will be captured by nearby units unless [core]stayNeutral:true is used
data.sections.action.switchToAggressiveT: Change to a built-in team that is aggressive to all other teams. Does not get captured.
data.sections.action.switchToTeam.descri: Team id to switch to. Starts at 0. (but -1 for a neutral team, -2 for aggressive Team). Also supports dynamic values
data.sections.action.takeResources.descr: Resources to take (required to use take resources). And at-least 1 include key is needed.
data.sections.action.takeResources_inclu: Take Resources Include Units In Transport
Includes cargo units in taking resources
Include attachment parent or transport parent
Includes referenced units in taking resources
Take Resources Include Units Within Range
Includes all units within the specified range
Take Resources Include Units Within Range Team
Used with includeUnitsWithinRange, defaults to own. Can be:  own|ally|allyNotOwn|enemy|neutral|any
data.sections.action.takeResources_exclu: Take Resources Exclude Units Without Tags
Excludes all units without the specified tags in taking resources
Take Resources Exclude Units With These Resources
Excludes all units with custom prices in them
Take Resources Exclude Units Without All Resources
data.sections.action.takeResources_trigg: Take Resources Trigger Action If Any Collected
Triggers an action if any amount of resources is collected in the current collection action
Take Resources Trigger Action If None Collected
Triggers an action if no amount of resources is collected in the current collection action
Take Resources Trigger Action For Each
Calls this action for each unit found by takeResource with the unit as thisActionTarget, and thisActionIndex counting up from zero.
data.sections.action.takeResources_disca: Just take resources from targets, don't add(or remove) to self
data.sections.action.takeResources_keepR: Take Resources Keep Resources On Target
Don't add/remove resource from target. This clones resources. Use with takeResources_discardCollected and takeResources_triggerActionIfAnyCollected to make a resource detector.
data.sections.action.takeResources_maxUn: Defaults to 1. Takes resources from specified amount of units
data.sections.action.takeResources_searc: Shortcut for maxUnits: 200, discardCollected: true, keepResourcesOnTarget: true to detect resources only
data.sections.action.takeResources_direc: Take Resources Direct Transfer Stopping At Zero
If less resources on target than transfer amount, only remaining resources will be transfered. Doesn't support use with some other takeResources_* keys
data.sections.action.convertResource_fro: Name of custom resource to take from
Name of custom resource to give to
data.sections.action.convertResource_min: Skip if less than this amount in 'from'. Defaults to 0. Likely not needed for most use cases
data.sections.action.convertResource_max: Max amount to transfer between 'from' and 'to'
data.sections.action.convertResource_mul: Defaults to 1. Amount to multiply when adding on 'to' (does not effect amount taken on 'from')
data.sections.action.resourceAmount.desc: Name of custom resource to set with the below 3 keys. All keys are optional, and can be used together.
data.sections.action.resourceAmount_setV: Absolute value to set this resource to, ignores current value of resource. Skipped by default
data.sections.action.resourceAmount_addO: Name of another custom resource to add to this on. Can be used without resourceAmount_setValue, to just add resources. Or with resourceAmount_setValue:0 to copy a resource value.
data.sections.action.resourceAmount_mult: Defaults to 1. Multiple the current or new value by
data.sections.action.attachments_deleteN: Removes a specified amount of units attached
data.sections.action.attachments_onlyOnS: Restrict attachments_* actions to these attachments
Unload all attachments. Can be used with attachments_onlyOnSlots. Same as unloading transported units
data.sections.action.attachments_disconn: Disconnect all attachments in the place they are right now. Can be used with attachments_onlyOnSlots.
data.sections.action.disconnectFromParen: Disconnects this unit from parent's attachment slot
Add tag to this unit until it is converted or reset (unless convertTo_keepCurrentTags is used)
data.sections.action.temporarilyRemoveTa: Remove tag from this unit until it is converted or reset (unless convertTo_keepCurrentTags is used)
data.sections.action.addGlobalTeamTags.d: Add a tag to player's team. Use with self.globalTeamTags() to create unlocks and upgrades. Unique tags are best to not conflict with other mods.
data.sections.action.removeGlobalTeamTag: Remove a tag from player's team.
data.sections.action.showMessageToPlayer: Sends a message to the player controlling the unit
Note: This format is support on nearly all strings that show to player even when reference doesn't show it. Use ISO 639-1 Language Code on the {LANG} placeholder
data.sections.action.showMessageToAllPla: Sends a message to all players
data.sections.action.showMessageToAllEne: Show Message To All Enemy Players
Sends a message to all enemy players only
data.sections.action.showQuickWarLogToPl: Show Quick War Log To Player
Sends a Quick War Log message to the player controlling the unit (in the lower lef)
data.sections.action.showQuickWarLogToAl: Show Quick War Log To All Players
Sends a Quick War Log message to all players (in the lower lef)
data.sections.action.debugMessage.descri: Only shows in Sandbox with Debug mode on.
data.sections.ai.useAsBuilder.descriptio: Set to true if unit can build or repair buildings. Defaults to [core]isBuilder.
data.sections.ai.useAsTransport.descript: Defaults to true if unit can transport units
data.sections.ai.useAsHarvester.descript: Defaults to true if unit can reclaim resources
data.sections.ai.disableUse.description: Disallow AI building this unit or building
data.sections.ai.ai_upgradePriority.desc: Defaults to 0.06. Set between 0-1, higher means AI is more likely to upgrade this unit before others
data.sections.ai.maxGlobal.description: Maximum amount allowed for a specific structure for an AI team per map
data.sections.ai.maxEachBase.description: Maximum amount allowed for a specific structure for an AI team per "base", usually around an extractor or spawn point. To check for an AI base in sandbox, enable Debug Mode and Click Shift + F3
data.sections.ai.buildPriority.descripti: 0-1. AI uses 0.8 for first land factory, 0.48 for air factory, 0.47 for first turret.
data.sections.ai.noneInBaseExtraPriority: Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the AIs base
data.sections.ai.noneGlobalExtraPriority: Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the any where on the map
data.sections.ai.recommendedInEachBasePr: Recommended In Each Base Priority If Unmet
Defaults to 0.5. Overrides buildPriority if recommended in base is too low.
data.sections.ai.upgradedFrom.descriptio: Create link to another unit to preserve max counts for upgraded and non-upgraded types in same base.
data.sections.ai.notPassivelyTargetedByO: Not Passively Targeted By Other Units
data.sections.ai.lowPriorityTargetForOth: Low Priority Target For Other Units
Useful for units that cannot attack back. Eg walls
data.sections.ai.whenUsingAsHarvester_re: When Using As Harvester Recommended In Each Base
Assigns unit of the same name with certain amount on an AI base
When Using As Harvester Recommended Global
Assigns unit of the same name with certain amount on map
data.sections.ai.whenUsingAsHarvester_in: When Using As Harvester Include Other Harvester Counts
Includes all harvester types on a single counter
data.sections.ai.onlyUseAsHarvester_ifBa: Only Use As Harvester If Base Has Unit Tagged
Only sets the harvester unit as a harvester if an AI base has a unit with particular tag(s)
data.sections.animation.onActions.descri: Automatically plays the animation on specified events. Options: move, attack, idle, underConstruction, underConstructionWithLinkedBuiltTime, queuedUnits, repair
data.sections.animation.onActionsQueuedU: On Actions Queued Unit Play At
For onAction: queuedUnits. Amount queue needs to reach before starting, set between 0-1
data.sections.animation.blendIn.descript: Blend with last animation for this time
data.sections.animation.blendOut.descrip: Blend with next animation for this time
data.sections.animation.pingPong.descrip: Play animation in reverse after it ends
data.sections.animation.KeyframeTimeScal: Scales all keyframe times, useful to make an animation faster/slower without changing everything
data.sections.animation.arm#_[time].desc: Adds a keyframe at time. Use multiple times to create animation.
data.sections.animation.leg#_[time].desc: Adds a keyframe at time. Use multiple times to create animation.
data.sections.animation.body_[time].desc: Adds a keyframe at time for body. Only frame and scale allowed on body
data.sections.animation.effect_[time].de: Spawn effects while playing an animation
Overrides [graphics]animation_direction_units while this animation is playing
data.sections.animation.scale_start.desc: Start scale. Deprecated, use body keyframes instead.
data.sections.animation.scale_end.descri: End scale. Deprecated, use body keyframes instead.
data.sections.animation.speed.descriptio: Speed, smaller is faster. Only effects start, end, scale_start, scale_end
data.sections.attachment.x.description: Sets the horizontal position of the attachment
data.sections.attachment.y.description: Sets the vertical position of the attachment
data.sections.attachment.height.descript: Sets the elevation of the attachment
data.sections.attachment.idleDir.descrip: Sets the direction of the attachment when idle
data.sections.attachment.idleDirReversin: Sets the direction of the attachment when the base unit is moving in reverse
data.sections.attachment.isVisible.descr: Defaults to true. If false, the attachment is hidden
data.sections.attachment.onCreateSpawnUn: Upon spawning the unit, specified attached unit is also spawned as attachment
Defaults to false. When true, the player cannot click the attachment.
data.sections.attachment.canAttack.descr: Defaults to true. Set to false to stop this attachment attacking.
data.sections.attachment.canBeAttackedAn: When true, the attachment is vulnerable to attacks
data.sections.attachment.deattachIfWanti: If the unit is ordered to move, it will detach. This includes waypoints from actions.
data.sections.attachment.lockLegMovement: Locks the leg movement while attached.
data.sections.attachment.setDrawLayerOnT: Renders the attachment above the base unit
data.sections.attachment.setDrawLayerOnB: Renders the attachment below the base unit
data.sections.attachment.addTransportedU: Often used with transport units, when true, attaches one of the unit passenger to this attachment slot
data.sections.attachment.lockRotation.de: When true, stops the attachment from rotating
data.sections.attachment.rotateWithParen: When true, the attachment rotates with the parent unit
data.sections.attachment.prioritizeParen: It will priotize targeting the main target. Defaults to true.
data.sections.attachment.alwaysAllowedTo: Always Allowed To Attack Parents Main Target
Will always attack the parents main target.

Defaults false. If true attached units are not converted when parent changes team. Eg from [projectile]convertHitToSourceTeam
data.sections.attachment.onConvertKeepEx: On Convert Keep Existing Unit In Same Slot
When true, the attachment is retained on the same attachment slot when the parent is converted to another unit

data.sections.attachment.smoothlyBlendPo: Smoothly Blend Position When Existing Unit Added
data.sections.attachment.showAllActionsF: Show all actions of the units attached in the parent unit list when selected
data.sections.attachment.createIncomplet: If parent hasn't been built, create attachment with the same built value. Links built values till attachment is complete. Useful for buildings built with nano.
data.sections.attachment.redirectDamageT: Redirects damage done to this attachment to the parent instead of damaging itself directly

When enemies attack the attachment, all damage are redirected to the parent's shield
data.sections.attack.canAttack.descripti: If set to false, can not attack any unit. Overrides other canAttack options altogether.
data.sections.attack.canAttackFlyingUnit: can also be narrowed per turret. Note: not required if canAttack is false.
can also be narrowed per turret in [turret_NAME]
data.sections.attack.canAttackUnderwater: can also be narrowed per turret in [turret_NAME]
data.sections.attack.canAttackNotTouchin: Can Attack Not Touching Water Units
Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos. (can also be set per turret)
data.sections.attack.shootDelay.descript: Global delay, can also use delay on each turret. Set in seconds or ticks
data.sections.attack.canOnlyAttackUnitsW: Can Only Attack Units With Tags
Will only attack units that has the specified tags.
Can Only Attack Units Without Tags

data.sections.movement.moveSpeed.descrip: Maximum movement speed of the unit. A value of 1 means (1 pixel * 60) per second (or 3 tiles per second)
data.sections.movement.moveAccelerationS: Defines how fast units accelerate to max speed.
data.sections.movement.moveDecelerationS: Don't make this too low or units will have trouble stopping at waypoints

data.sections.movement.targetHeight.desc: Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 35
data.sections.movement.targetHeightDrift: Smooth animated height change. Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 1.5

data.sections.placementRule.anyRuleInGro: Only require 1 of the rules in this group pass, instead of all. Use the same group name on other placement rules to create a group.
data.sections.placementRule.searchTags.d: Search for any unit with at least one of these tags
data.sections.placementRule.searchTeam.d: Teams to include in search, can be: own|neutral|allyNotOwn|ally|enemy|any
data.sections.placementRule.excludeIncom: defaults to false. Might want to set to true depending on the requirement reason
data.sections.placementRule.minCount.des: Set min amount of units that need to be found in search. (eg needs to be near something). Defaults to 0
data.sections.placementRule.maxCount.des: Set max amount of units before match fails (eg cannot be close to something). Defaults to unlimited
data.sections.placementRule.cannotPlaceM: Highly Recommended. Message shown to player if this rule fails (will be first failing rule if using anyRuleInGroup).
data.sections.placementRule.checkEachTil: defaults to true (set to false to only test unit center, true checks each tile under the unit which shows up on the placement grid. Can be easier to see requirements with true)
data.sections.projectile.life.descriptio: How long till this projectile gets removed if it hasn't hit a target, 300 might be a good starting point, change depending on speed and range
data.sections.projectile.deflectionPower: Defaults to 1. Energy needed for laser defence to deflect. -1 to disable deflection (only disable for special weapons like flames)
data.sections.projectile.explodeOnEndOfL: Default to false. True to explode at end of life with all side effects and area damage instead of disappearing. Good for making area-denial weapons.
data.sections.projectile.autoTargetingOn: Retarget to nearby unit if target dies while in transit
Auto Targeting On Dead Target Range
The range which it will select a new target if old target has died
Auto Targeting On Dead Target Lead
The lead it will try to have on the new target
data.sections.projectile.unloadUpToXUnit: Unload Up To X Units From Source
Unload X units from source unit, to projectile explode location
Move unit that shot this projectile to projectile explode location
data.sections.projectile.spawnUnit.descr: Spawn new units of this type at projectile explode location
data.sections.projectile.spawnProjectile: Spawn Projectiles On End Of Life
Spawns new projectiles on end of life, useful for secondary projectiles
Projectiles to spawns when this projectile hits it's target
Spawns projectiles on creation of this projectile, useful for making true shotgun-like projectile spread
data.sections.projectile.convertHitToSou: Convert units hit to the team that fired this projectile. Useful to make capturing systems
data.sections.projectile.tags.descriptio: Used for projectile interceptions (e.g. Nuke and Anti-Nuke Interaction) and in [action] autoTriggerOnEvent: tookDamage(withTag="[tagName]")
data.sections.projectile.flameWeapon.des: Generates small flames on hit (only cosmetic)
data.sections.projectile.delayedStartTim: Hide for x time before showing and updating effect.
data.sections.projectile.directDamage.de: Damage to target unit on hit. Does not work with targetGround:true as it won't have a clear unit to target
data.sections.projectile.areaDamage.desc: Damages on arrival of target with an area effect, use areaRadius to adjust size of damage. targetGround needs this to damage
data.sections.projectile.areaRadius.desc: How wide areaDamage effects. Note this drops off (unless areaDamageNoFalloff is used)
data.sections.projectile.areaRadiusFromE: Applies damage from edge of units instead of center. Mostly effects large units.
Applies area damage as an expanding blast wave rather than instantly. Useful for nuke projectiles
data.sections.projectile.areaHitAirAndLa: Area Hit Air And Land At Same Time
data.sections.projectile.areaIgnoreUnits: Units closer than this range aren't effected. Rarely needed. Not recommended for normal projectiles.
data.sections.projectile.shieldDamageMul: Defaults to 1. 0 to do no damage to shields and 2 to do double damage
data.sections.projectile.shieldDefection: Defaults to 1. The amount of shield to bypass. 0 to ignore shields and directly damage hull
data.sections.projectile.hullDamageMulti: Defaults to 1. Can be used to create EMP weapons that affect shields only. 0 to ignore hull and only damage shields
data.sections.projectile.ignoreParentSho: Sets whether multipliers are applied or not regardless of multipliers set in attack or setUnitStats
data.sections.projectile.armourIgnoreAmo: Amount of armour to ignore on target and do damage as if this armour was not there
data.sections.projectile.friendlyFire.de: Lets area effect projectiles damage own team units (can't damage allies). Useful for nuke-like weapons
data.sections.projectile.mutatorX_ifUnit: Mutator X If Unit With Tags
Applies mutators to this projectile if target has corresponding tags
Mutator X If Unit Without Tags
Same as ifUnitWithTags, but applies if target doesn't have the set tags
data.sections.projectile.mutatorX_direct: Changes directDamage. Defaults to 1. Be careful not to confuse players using this as the effect may not be clear. Use amour instead when possible. Replace X with desired name
data.sections.projectile.mutatorX_areaDa: Same as directDamageMultiplier but for areaDamage. Defaults to 1.
data.sections.projectile.mutatorX_change: Change explode effect if this mutator is active. Eg make a bounce off amour effect. Helps to make the damage change more clear to players (Doesn't work with targetGround.)
data.sections.projectile.mutatorX_addRes: Mutator X Add Resources Direct Hit
Add resource to all direct hit units. Warning: Be careful not be break units from other mods by adding random resources or energy to them that they don't expect.
Mutator X Add Resources Area Hit
Add resource to all area hit units. Warning: Be careful not be break units from other mods by adding random resources or energy to them that they don't expect.
data.sections.projectile.targetGround.de: Target ground, and don't home in on target. Note: only areaDamage is applied if targeting ground.
data.sections.projectile.targetGround_in: Default false. for area affect AA weapons
data.sections.projectile.targetGroundHei: Default 0. for shooting over or under a target. Useful for projectiles that split and rain down.
data.sections.projectile.targetSpeedAcce: Controls the speed rampup for targetSpeed
data.sections.projectile.ballistic.descr: Makes projectiles fly up into the air and come down, instead of going in a straight line
data.sections.projectile.ballistic_delay: Sets up to how high the projectile needs to be before moving normally
data.sections.projectile.ballistic_heigh: Sets the target height of the projectile
data.sections.projectile.targetGroundSpr: Randomly makes the shot inaccurate by this amount. Also used by weapons like the flamethrower
data.sections.projectile.speedSpread.des: Randomly change the starting projectile speed by this amount
data.sections.projectile.instantReuseLas: Recycles last projectile fired, only one projectile ever exists. Can turn lasers into beam weapons by using lower rate of fire and setting this to true
Instant Reuse Last Also Change Turret Aim
Make turret's aim include last projectile's spread and sweep offsets, useful for beam weapons
Instant Reuse Last Keep Area Damage List
Default false. Keeping the list was the normal behaviour in 1.13 making area damage not apply a second time but this is not useful. Use this only if you want the old behaviour.
data.sections.projectile.interceptProjec: Intercept Projectile Remove Target Life Only
Defaults to false. When false projectiles are just removed. Could be true to make hit projectiles explode or split when hit
data.sections.projectile.disableLeadTarg: Disable the lead targeting calculations when aiming at a moving target. Defaults false.
data.sections.projectile.leadTargetingSp: The expected speed of this projectile for targetGround lead target calculation. Defaults to 'targetSpeed' if set otherwise 'speed'.
data.sections.projectile.initialUnguided: Sets vertical speed for projectiles with targetGround. Use gravity to make smooth arching projectiles. Better have gravity value slightly slower than this key to produce the arches.
data.sections.projectile.gravity.descrip: Controls the pull for projectiles that target ground. Use together with initialUnguidedSpeedHeight
data.sections.projectile.turnSpeed.descr: Limits the turn speed of a projectile, making them inaccurate even with directDamage. Zero value will make it act like if targetGround is set true, but air target friendly option.
data.sections.projectile.wobbleAmplitude: How wide the projectile will wobble
data.sections.projectile.wobbleFrequency: How often the projectile will wobble
data.sections.projectile.pushForce.descr: Push (or pull with a negative value) the units that get hit. Divided by target mass
data.sections.projectile.pushVelocity.de: Push (or pull with a negative value) the units that get hit. Ignores target mass
Move projectile as parent moves. Useful for beam effects that need to stick to source turret.
data.sections.projectile.sweepOffsetFrom: Add to sweep offset by factor of target's radius. 0.4 would be 40%
data.sections.projectile.retargetingInFl: Can retarget a new target mid-flight, perfect for flak-style weapons and projectiles that collide
How long between searching for new targets. Default 5
Range which targets are reselected. Default 120
The lead of the projectile to try to hit the target. Default 15
Retargeting In Flight Search Only Tags
Only retarget units with these tags
data.sections.projectile.color.descripti: Recolors this projectile using a hex value.
data.sections.projectile.invisible.descr: When true, the projectile is not rendered but still functional.
data.sections.projectile.image.descripti: Use custom image. Overrides drawType and frame
data.sections.projectile.drawType.descri: Built-in image to use. 0:projectiles.png 1:projectiles_large.png 2:projectiles2.png. Refer to end of sheet for the projectile images.
data.sections.projectile.frame.descripti: Built-in image frame to use, starts at zero.
data.sections.projectile.explodeEffect.d: Produces the specified effects upon explosion.
data.sections.projectile.explodeEffectOn: Use this effect if shield is active on target
Mix 0-1 of team colour into color field
data.sections.projectile.teamColorRatio_: default is (1-teamColorRatio). Keep more of color when mixing. Note this might saturate colors.
If true, renders the projectile under units. Great for torpedos.
Produces specified effects upon creation of the projectile.
data.sections.projectile.shouldRevealFog: Reveal fog to player on explode
data.sections.projectile.alwaysVisibleIn: Renders the projectile even when fog is present
data.sections.projectile.nukeWeapon.desc: Shows on mini-map when fired. Some other side effects as well, like nuke explosion effect
data.sections.projectile.trailEffect.des: true for built-in defaults, but can also point to any custom effects
data.sections.projectile.lightSize.descr: Sets the size of the light emitted by the projectile. 1 value = 1 tile
data.sections.projectile.lightColor.desc: Sets the color of the light emitted by the projectile.
Creates a large explosion and accompanying sound on hit (only cosmetic)
Draw as lighting works best with instant:true
data.sections.projectile.laserEffect.des: Draw as laser works best with instant:true
data.sections.projectile.beamImage.descr: Image to use for beam and laser effect type projectiles. Image is repeated vertically depending on the distance to target. Beam image should be 20 pixels or longer. Width does not matter, only the height.
data.sections.projectile.beamImageOffset: Sets how fast the beam image moves towards or away from the target
Sprite for the origin point of the custom beam
data.sections.projectile.beamImageStartR: Defaults false. True to rotate with turret angle
data.sections.projectile.beamImageEnd.de: Sprite for the end point of the custom beam
data.sections.resource.displayName.descr: Name of this resource in UI (eg hovering over unit info)
Shorter version of resource name used on some text ui
data.sections.resource.hidden.descriptio: Hide this resource from the player
data.sections.resource.equivalentGlobalR: Used to hint to the AI that a resource node with a local resources could be used to get a different global resource. Eg when a harvester unloads the resource
data.sections.resource.displayRoundedDow: Rounds off resource values with decimals
data.sections.resource.iconImage.descrip: Custom icon image for the resource
data.sections.resource.displayNameHideWh: Display Name Hide When Icon Shown In Text
Hide display name when icon is shown in text
Display Name Hide When Icon Shown In HUD
Hide display name when icon is shown in HUD

Add gap when appending resource in text

Append resource in HUD even when this resource is zero

Spawn the unit on the last attacker of source (useful on [core]unitsSpawnedOnDeath)
data.value.spawnUnits.spawnChance.descri: Chance this unit will spawn. Defaults to 1.
data.value.spawnUnits.spawnSource.descri: Changes spawn location and team of spawned units to this unit ref.
data.value.spawnUnits.maxSpawnLimit.desc: Useful with spawnChance, max number of units to spawn in total
data.value.spawnUnits.gridAlign.descript: Align spawn location to grid, useful for buildings
Don't spawn this unit if spawn in an invalid location. Eg on units or over water when LAND based
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetX.descriptio: Sets horizontal position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetY.descriptio: Sets vertical position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetDir.descript: Set the facing direction of spawned units
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetHeight.descr: Sets the height for spawned units
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetRandomX.desc: Sets random horizontal position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetRandomY.desc: Sets random vertical position relative to source
data.value.spawnUnits.offsetRandomDir.de: Set random facing direction of spawned units
data.value.spawnUnits.addResources.descr: Give spawn unit those resources, can be used to set flags that trigger actions
data.value.spawnUnits.transportedUnitsTo: Puts the designated amount of transported units into the transport of the spawned unit.
Copies all waypoints on target to created units.
data.value.spawnUnits.alwayStartDirAtZer: Sets the direction of spawned unit to 0 degrees.
data.value.spawnUnits.techLevel.descript: Usually used in BR maps, controls the size of safe zone markers and damaging borders. 1 techLevel = 10x10 tiles = 200 pixels in diameter
data.sections.turret.x.description: Sets the horizontal position of the turret. 0 is center, negatives toward left, positives toward right.
data.sections.turret.y.description: Sets the vertical position of the turret. 0 is center, negatives toward bottom, positives toward top.
data.sections.turret.copyFrom.descriptio: Copy all values from another turret as defaut values for this turret
data.sections.turret.altProjectile.descr: Alternative projectile fired from this turret when altProjectileCondition is true
data.sections.turret.barrelX.description: Defaults to 0. Controls horizontal position for projectile spawn.
data.sections.turret.barrelY.description: Defaults to size. Note: size and barrelY have the same meaning
data.sections.turret.barrelHeight.descri: Height of barrel in 3d. Effect projectile and shoot flame starting height
data.sections.turret.height.description: Height of the unit in 3D, to be used with decals
data.sections.turret.size.description: Controls the distance between the center of the turret and the point from where projectiles spawn.
data.sections.turret.turnSpeed.descripti: Max turn speed of the turret
data.sections.turret.turnSpeedAccelerati: Defaults to disabled, and full turn speed is used.
data.sections.turret.turnSpeedDecelerati: Defaults to turnSpeedAcceleration. Setting this higher than turn acceleration might allow faster targets to be hit
data.sections.turret.idleDirReversing.de: Defaults to idleDir+180 unless attached to another turret (as attached turret will often be rotating when reversing)
data.sections.turret.shouldResetTurret.d: Defaults true. False to disable the reseting turret angle when idle
data.sections.turret.idleSpin.descriptio: Spin rate when idle, used on missile turrets
data.sections.turret.idleSweepAngle.desc: Disabled by default. Controls how far the turret will "look" left and right
data.sections.turret.idleSweepDelay.desc: Controls the delay between idleSweep movements
data.sections.turret.idleSweepSpeed.desc: Controls the speed with which the turret sweeps when idle
data.sections.turret.idleSweepAddRandomD: Default 1-20 depends on idleSweepDelay, used to stop sweep syncing up with other units
data.sections.turret.attachedTo.descript: A specific turret to connect to, it will rotate with it. No correlation to [attachment_x]
data.sections.turret.slave.description: Locks this turret's direction and shot cooldown to attached turret. Often used with warmup for multiple barrel guns
data.sections.turret.isMainNanoTurret.de: Defaults to false. Turret to use for creating buildings, etc. should only be true on one turret, and should have canShoot set to false
data.sections.turret.energyUsage.descrip: Required energy to fire weapon. Same as resourceUsage: energy=X
data.sections.turret.resourceUsage.descr: can be in credits/energy/hp/shield/ammo. Stops firing if not met
data.sections.turret.delay.description: Override global shootDelay for this turret
data.sections.turret.linkDelayWithTurret: When this other turret fires the cooldown delay on this turret will be reset/removed
Rate to reduce warmup when turret is not ready to fire at any targets

data.sections.turret.warmupShootDelayTra: Defaults to 0, amount to reduces the next shot delay depending on warmup. When used with warmupNoReset, can make a each shot faster.
data.sections.turret.onShoot_freezeBodyM: On Shoot Freeze Body Movement For

0 by default. Sets a barrelX offset only during odd numbered shots, useful for twin-barreled units. Use with barrelX. Use the opposite value of barrelX for most cases.
data.sections.turret.aimOffsetSpread.des: Sets the shot inaccuracy. 0 will make all shots land on target's center

Default true. If false unit cannot attack surface units.
data.sections.turret.canAttackUnderwater: Default true. If false unit cannot attack underwaterunits.
data.sections.turret.canAttackNotTouchin: Can Attack Not Touching Water Units
Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos.
data.sections.turret.canOnlyAttackUnitsW: Can Only Attack Units With Tags
Only attacks potential targets with specific tags
Can Only Attack Units Without Tags
Only attacks potential targets without specific tags
Normally, used to optionally disable a turret based on a LogicBoolean. Eg: this unit's height
data.sections.turret.canAttackMaxAngle.d: Max angle to target for turret to be allowed for fire. Defaults to 5, don't set lower. Can be set to 181 for turrets that don't need to turn to fire missiles.
data.sections.turret.clearTurretTargetAf: Clears the turrets sub-target when using multi-targeting
data.sections.turret.limitingRange.descr: Make this turret have less range than the maxAttackRange. Do not apply this to all turrets change maxAttackRange instead.
data.sections.turret.limitingAngle.descr: Linked with idleDir. Turret will only be able to fire at units +/- this angle.
data.sections.turret.interceptProjectile: Intercept Projectiles And Targeting Ground Under Distance
Minimum distance required for intercepting projectile
Defaults to 2000, distance inflight before firing
Defaults to 0. Sets the projectile target height limit
data.sections.turret.laserDefenceEnergyU: Set to enable a projectile laser defence from this turret. Should also set the energyMax in core.
data.sections.turret.invisible.descripti: Don't render this turret, but still can shoot, etc.
data.sections.turret.image.description: Use custom image. Overrides unit's main turret image
data.sections.turret.image_applyTeamColo: When true, the specific turret applies team colors over the special greens in the sprite.
data.sections.turret.image_drawOffsetX.d: Moves the image horizontally from the turret center.
data.sections.turret.image_drawOffsetY.d: Moves the image verticallly from the turret center.
data.sections.turret.chargeEffectImage.d: Used with warmup. Shows a scaling effect image on turret barrel when charging.
data.sections.turret.warmupStartEffect.d: Spawns specified effects when the specific turret is charging/warming up
data.sections.turret.shoot_sound.descrip: Can be linked to an .ogg or .wav file, or one of the default game sounds (list at bottom of reference)
data.sections.turret.shoot_sound_vol.des: Sets the volume of the shoot sound
data.sections.turret.shoot_flame.descrip: Current types are: small, large, smoke, shockwave, or CUSTOM: effectSectionName
data.sections.turret.shoot_light.descrip: Produces a colored light upon shooting
data.sections.turret.onShoot_playAnimati: Play a custom animation from an [animation] section after firing this turret
data.sections.turret.onShoot_triggerActi: Trigger these actions each time this turret fires
data.sections.turret.unloadUpToXUnitsAnd: Unload Up To X Units And Give Attack Order
Unloads X units at turret barrel locations and gives them the attack order of turret target
data.sections.turret.recoilOffset.descri: Push turret forward or back after firing for a recoil effect. Value in pixels.
data.sections.turret.recoilOutTime.descr: Time to get to offset position after firing
data.sections.turret.recoilReturnTime.de: Time to return to default position
data.sections.turret.showRangeUIGuide.de: Defaults to true. Displays the attack range for this turret
